rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb on busy Carmody Road where cars park, homes 10-16 m away.
reasons: Plain kerb on a busy road

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 10-16 m behind hedges and a garden on this side; a pool house is nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb has a parked car and some grass verge; room to stop looks tight on a busy road.
drivers.traffic: Wide four-lane road with centre line and steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out.

sun_shade: Open to the sun, with some tree shade from the east.

best_section.where: East kerb of Carmody Road, north of the side street junction
